label: copy phase: fed-back a, strongest when the next output is r (the a-r bigram)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (nothing in the original or delimiter steps). The step input is almost always the fed-back token a (94% of activation mass); a few weak activations come on input r (e.g. r r). Magnitude depends mostly on the token being output next: a followed by r (copying an a-r bigram) gives the top activations and 62% of mass (a and out=r at recall_idx>=3 has precision 0.88), and a followed by f or o is weaker. It is close to silent before recall_idx 3 (late-copy positions). Most copy-phase a inputs (95%) do not fire, so a alone has very low precision. Weak low-quartile activations on a followed by other tokens are not captured by the predicate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=a (+7.25), in_tok=a (+4.36), phase=2 & in_tok=r (+4.26), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+3.53), next_out=r (+3.40), out_tok=r (+3.31). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.50), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.52), recall_idx=1 (-3.52), phase=2 & out_tok=v (-3.39).
